newsitem.title: FINLAND: RTZ-CRA to study Finnish talc find.
newsitem.headline: RTZ-CRA to study Finnish talc find.

text.p: French Talc de Luzenac, a unit of mining group RTZ-CRA, has won a tender to investigate a talc find in Sotkamo in northern Finland, the Finnish Ministry of Trade and Industry (KTM) said in a statement on Wednesday.
"Following negotiations held after receiving the tenders, the ministry decided to grant Talc de Luzenac the rights to further investigate the talc find," KTM said.
Two companies had submitted tenders for investigation and mining rights by the November 15 deadline, it said.

Luzenac will during two years study the quantity, quality and potential profitability of the Sotkamo talc find, KTM said, adding the company would start preparing for mining operations if the results were encouraging.
Luzenac is the world's biggest talc producer operating at 15 locations in Europe and North America, the ministry said.
